notes.text: Completion of the minor requires six courses or 18 credits.
AAS 210, AAS 232, AAS 305, AAS 311, and AAS 336 may be used for either Requirement 1 (Core) or Requirement 2 (Electives), but not both.

Courses marked with an (*) are crosslisted with at least one other academic department. Students earn credit by registering for either course but may not repeat the course by enrolling a second time under the other option.
